name: table
label: Table
description: Select the table data to display in the list. Optionally, you can add a fixed filter to display specific records from the selected table. Users can't edit or remove a fixed filter.

name: fixedQuery
label: fixed filter
description: Apply fixed query filters to filter the list. These will not be removable at runtime.

name: view
label: View
description: Preconfigured columns selection, as defined in the [sys_ui_view] table.

name: columns
label: Columns
description: Columns to render. If this property is set, a predefined view cannot be chosen.

name: maxColumns
label: Number of displayed columns
description: If the view that you selected has too many columns, you can pare down to a manageable size by setting the maximum number of displayed columns. For example, if a view adds 15 columns, you can display only the first 5 columns. This property will also apply to manually selected columns.

name: query
label: filter
description: Users can edit or remove this filter. If you set a fixed filter, this filter adds more conditions that further specify which records to display.

name: groupByField
label: Group by
description: Group records by a specific column. For example, you can group a list of employees by office location.

name: hideHighlightedValues
label: Hide highlighted values
description: Select to prevent highlighted values from appearing on this list. If highlighted values are enabled, you can select a predefined highlighted value configuration.

name: hideHighlightContent
label: Hide highlighted content
description: Select to disable the ability to highlight text (typically used in conjunction with search results)

name: highlightContent
label: Highlighted content
description: Specify text that should be highlighted in the list

name: hideLinks
label: Hide links
description: Select to hide all links in the list; reference fields and links will render as plain text

name: isRefList
label: Use plain text for references
description: Select to prevent reference fields from being clickable in the list

name: wordWrap
label: Enable word wrap
description: Select to wrap text in all columns

name: overrideWordWrapUserPref
label: Override word wrap user preference
description: Select to override the end user's word wrap preference, and always observe the word wrap property set here

name: maxCharLimit
label: Maximum characters
description: Specify the character limit to be displayed until truncating

name: hideEmptyStateImage
label: Hide empty state image
description: Select to hide the empty state image from appearing when the list has no data

name: hidePersonalization
label: Hide option to personalize columns
description: Select to disable the ability to add, remove, and change the order of columns in the list at runtime

name: hideDotwalk
label: Disable dotwalk
description: Select to disable dotwalk capability in list personalization (The flag is effective only when Hide column personalization flag is off)

name: hideColumnReorder
label: Hide option to drag-and-drop columns
description: Sets whether to allow a user to reorder a column by dragging it to a different position

name: hideRowSelector
label: Disallow selecting records
description: Select to hide the row selector checkboxes

name: hideSelectAll
label: Hide option to select all records
description: Select to disable the ability to select all records in a list

name: hideCheckboxHover
label: Show checkboxes only on hover
description: Select to prevent the checkbox hover functionality, and always display checkboxes on the list (if applicable)

name: hideUnnecessaryRowSelectors
label: Hide selection if action is unavailable
description: Select to hide checkboxes on any rows that have no possible actions to take

name: hideColumnGrouping
label: Hide option to group records
description: Select to disable column grouping functionality

name: hideColumnResizing
label: Hide column resizing
description: Select to disable the ability to drag and resize column widths

name: hideColumnFiltering
label: Hide column filtering
description: Select to disable the ability to apply filters from the column heading

name: hideColumnSorting
label: Hide column sorting
description: Select to disable the ability to sort a list from the column header.

name: hideCellFilter
label: Hide cell filtering
description: Select to hide the cell filter popover and prevent the ability to filter cells by 'show matching' and 'filter out'

name: hideQuickEdit
label: Hide option to quick edit
description: Select to disable the quick edit functionality, which provides the ability to access the record in a side panel

name: hideHeader
label: Hide header
description: Select to hide the list's header and all of its contents

name: headerSize
label: Size
description: Configures header size

name: headingLevel
label: Title level
description: Configures heading level

name: hideTitle
label: Hide title
description: Select to hide the title from appearing in the list header

name: listTitle
label: Title
description: Title to display at the top of the list

name: hideTitleRowCount
label: Hide total number of records
description: Select to hide the row count from appearing in the list header

name: hideLastRefreshedText
label: Hide last refresh information
description: Select to hide the Last Refreshed text from appearing in the list header

name: hideDeclarativeActions
label: Hide list actions
description: Select to prevent list declarative actions from appearing on this list

name: actionConfigId
label: List actions configuration
description: The action configuration you want to use to populate the declarative actions

name: columnPreferenceKey
label: Column Preference Key
description: The key to use for sourcing and saving a user preference which specifies the columns to show and in what order. This is meant to be used as a fallback in situations where the component can not correctly determine the default key to be used to save a user preference. By default, if maxColumns or columns are set for the component, column preferences are stored using the page id instead of the default behavior of updating the platform wide list layout. If page id cannot be determined, the component can use this key as the fallback. The key must contain lowercase letters and numbers only and must be between 24 and 32 characters.

name: hideRefreshButton
label: Hide option to refresh
description: Select to hide the refresh button in the list header, thus disabling the ability to refresh the list

name: hideOptionToSaveAs
label: Hide option to save as
description: Select to disable the option for users to save this list as a 'My List'

name: hideListSharing
label: Hide option to copy URL
description: Select to hide the sharing button from appearing in the list header

name: hideFilterPanel
label: Hide filter panel button
description: Select to hide the filter panel (and access to condition builder) from appearing in the list header

name: hidePanelFooter
label: Hide filter panel footer
description: Select to hide the entire footer of the filter panel

name: hidePanelRestore
label: Hide filter panel restore
description: Select to hide the button that provides the ability to restore back default filters

name: hidePanelAdvanced
label: Hide filter panel advanced
description: Select to hide the filter panel advanced filter toggle button

name: hidePanelConditionDelete
label: Hide option to delete filter conditions
description: Select to prevent the ability to remove filters on the list

name: hidePagination
label: Hide pagination
description: Select to hide the list pagination and all associated controls

name: hideRange
label: Hide range
description: Select to hide the count of records appearing on the page

name: hideRowCount
label: Hide row count
description: Select to hide the total count of records in the list

name: page
label: Initial page
description: Initial page to render

name: hidePages
label: Hide numbered pages
description: Select to hide the page numbers within the pagination

name: hideFirstPage
label: Hide first page
description: Select to hide the first page control

name: hidePreviousPage
label: Hide previous page
description: Select to hide the previous page control

name: hideNextPage
label: Hide next page
description: Select to hide the next page control

name: hideLastPage
label: Hide last page
description: Select to hide the last page control

name: hideLimitSelector
label: Hide rows per page selector
description: Select to prevent the ability to change the number of records to be displayed per page

name: nrlLandmark
label: Include in landmark keyboard shortcut
description: Landmarks define main elements on the page. When you set this property to true, the component will be included in the landmark keyboard shortcut cycling behavior, allowing users to quickly jump focus back-and-forth between the main elements on the page.

name: limit
label: Maximum rows
description: Maximum number of records to render as rows

name: menuSelection
label: Menu selection
description: The target table that the selected list from the list menu belongs to

name: hideMenuButton
label: Hide menu button
description: Select to hide the menu button (and its options within) from appearing in the list header

name: listMenuOpen
label: Collapse list menu icon
description: Controls which way the list menu icon points to indicate if the list menu is open or closed

name: hideInlineEditing
label: Hide inline editing
description: Select to disable inline editing functionality

name: hideDragDrop
label: Hide drag and drop
description: Select to disable the ability to drag and drop rows (it is not recommended to use this in conjunction with sorting)

name: allRecordsSelected
label: Mark all rows selected
description: Select to select all rows in the table

name: selectedListId
label: List ID
description: The ID of the list

name: tiny
label: Tiny ID
description: A generated ID that represents a shared list and its applied conditions

name: error
label: Error
description: The information to display when an error occurs

name: selectedRecords
label: Selected records
description: Controls the ability to select one or more rows on the page

name: exceptedRecords
label: Excepted records
description: If all rows selected, controls the ability to deselect one or more rows on the page

name: refreshRequested
label: Refresh requested
description: An object containing a timestamp that can be passed down to trigger a refresh

name: recordSelectedTable
label: Record selected table
description: The table name of a record that a user has selected from the list

name: recordSelectedSysId
label: Record selected sysID
description: The Sys ID of a record that a user has selected from the list

name: recordSelectedQuery
label: Record selected query
description: The query conditions of a record that a user has selected from the list

name: recordSelectedView
label: Record selected view
description: The view of a record that a user has selected from the list

name: daClientActionContract
label: DA client action contract
description: The contract that UI Builder uses to dynamically build the available declarative actions for event mapping
